answer.summary: Three deterministic ArchUnit architecture tests failed (3 failures, build exit 1), and the violations come from code this branch adds. ThreatArsenalService.isNameAvailable calls PayloadIdentity.getId() and injectorContract(String) without a tenant argument, and PayloadService.assertNameAvailable self-invokes the @Transactional isNameAvailable. These are not infrastructure or flake signals (0 flakes on the first two tests, and the history shows no prior persistence for this change), so a re-run will fail the same way. Fix the layering and transaction violations, or add a reviewed allowlist entry.
